findings.issue: This row completes 'Until I allowed...' (same node, 'حتى سمحتُ لـ...'). 'inside' is the adverb of 'allowed [it] inside' - the preacher let the Passenger IN to himself. بداخله turns it into a possessive 'inside HIM', inventing a third party and leaving the joined sentence ungrammatical (حتى سمحتُ لـ... الراكب المقدّس بداخله).

findings.source_en: It’s the godling’s flesh I seek. This… “Lavender.”
findings.ar: لحم الإله الصغير هو ما أنشده. هذه… «لافندر».
findings.issue: 'Lavender' is the in-world name of the Harbinger and of the godling named in the same sentence - both masculine (النذير، إله صغير). The feminine هذه contradicts الإله الصغير in its own line.
findings.suggested_ar: لحم الإله الصغير هو ما أنشده. هذا… «لافندر».

findings.issue: Same masculine referent (Lavender = the Harbinger). Duplicated with the identical row in chunk 047; both need the same fix.
